status: Exploratory estimator specified after the old source readouts, before the two-phase aggregate; the physical source and original U target are unchanged
source: s=CB+CW under a common microscopic paired-cluster fugacity exp(t*s); internal source arrays use s/N and every reported source response is multiplied by N

crossfit.features: direction-specific a,c*q,d*E and one pair-common b*K/N; coefficients fixed under thermal differentiation
crossfit.omission: source delete-one refits every affected training fold and weights retained heldout folds by their actual sizes

complement: Full original production minus all marked100k permutations. Subtract exact q/E sums from original batch0. The complement and marks have disjoint counter intervals; common cyclic-size counter dependencies remain paired.
baseline: Complement pooled root, matching slope, q/E thermal jets and analytic three-state source response. Retain the original U and root/slope normalization. Raw comparator keeps its already computed marked-only estimator.
decomposition: two_phase=L_C[c_g*q+d_g*E]+L_C[R]; common constants and pair-common K clock have exactly zero contribution. This is one source decomposition, not multiple evidence votes.
source_covariance: Reuse the same three marked-data dependency groups,100 equal1000-permutation batches. Refit source coefficients on each delete-one. Raw comparator uses its saved matching delete-one vector, not a rerun.
complement_covariance: For each original dependency group use actual remaining batch weights h_b. z_b=(1-h_b)/h_b*(theta-theta_minus_b); V=sum_b h_b*(z_b-weighted_mean(z))*(z_b-weighted_mean(z))^T/(B-1). This is first-order influence covariance under identically distributed independent permutation keys within a group, not a general heterogeneous-cluster sandwich.
joint_uncertainty: Add disjoint source and complement covariance contributions, preserving within-group cross-N/direction dependence and all cross-estimator/component covariance. Higher-order source-by-baseline interaction and finite ratio bias are not an exact coverage certificate.
generator_comparison: All three source-estimator views use the same high-precision complement U for the single-generator-drift determinant. The raw source estimator still retains its own marked-only root and slopes; its U is also saved for provenance.
hypotheses: The previous explicitly stated common-fugacity source-rigidity and one-generator-drift extensions are unchanged. Neither a source-tangent null nor a compatible drift determinant rescues an excluded unperturbed law.
success_output: Actual six-size source responses, q2/Jordan extension residuals, generator-drift contrasts, estimator differences, full covariance and measured SE changes. No claimed gain until computed, no selecting whichever view gives the smallest p.
resources: Existing CSV and git-pinned full histograms only; no configuration replay, new counters, server, GPU or test suite
report_surface: User-requested repository Python/JSON/Markdown artifacts. Technical answer-first report with definitions, paired comparisons, uncertainty and next calculation; no separate MCP/HTML/Sites publication or generic validation workflow.
